page.x_confirmaremosOPedidoPorResposta: We will confirm the request by reply and delete the data within 30 days.
page.x_suaContaOEMail: Your account, email, username and profile photo.
page.x_seusMuraisETodosOs: Your boards and all the pins you posted, and the uploaded files (photos, drawings, audio and videos).
page.x_notificacoesBottonsECreditosDa: Notifications, buttons and credits of the account.
page.x_registrosDePagamentosPodemSer: Payment records may be kept for as long as the law requires. If you used Facebook login, you can also remove Pinz in Facebook Settings → Apps and Websites.

page.x_oPinzPinzDigitalE: Pinz (pinz.digital) is a message board. This page explains which data we use and why.
page.x_contaEMailNomeDe: Account: email, username (nickname) and, if you upload one, the profile photo. If you sign in with Google, we receive the email and name of the Google account.
page.x_dataDeNascimentoOpcionalSe: Date of birth (optional): if you enter it at the welcome step, we keep it to confirm you are 13 or older. Only you can access it; it is not shown to anyone.
page.x_conteudoOsPinsQueVoce: Content: the pins you post (texts, lists, photos, drawings, audio, videos, songs and places), the question and answer that protect your board, and the shared board password (stored encrypted).
page.x_visitasESeguidoresQuandoVoce: Visits and followers: when you sign in and visit another person's board, your @ and profile photo appear in their visitor list (without a date). The people you follow are in a list only you see, and people who follow you appear only as a number.
page.x_enquetesAoVotarNumaEnquete: Polls: when you vote in a poll, we store the option you chose linked to your account (one vote per person); the board owner sees only the total and percentages, never who voted for what.
page.x_localizacaoSoQuandoVocePermite: Location (only when you allow it): if the board has a Weather display, the browser or phone asks whether it can use your location to show the weather where you are. See the “Location” section.
page.x_usoNotificacoesDaSuaConta: Usage: your account notifications, board view counts and technical security logs, such as the IP address, to prevent abuse.
page.x_criarSuaContaPermitirO: Create your account, allow login and show your board and pins.
page.x_enviarEMailsDaConta: Send account emails, such as the confirmation code.
page.x_moderarConteudoAtenderDenunciasE: Moderate content, handle reports and protect the service against abuse.
page.x_naoVendemosSeusDados: We do not sell your data.
page.x_oDisplayDeClimaMostra: The Weather display shows the weather where you are, and only if you allow it. The permission is requested by the browser or phone itself, and you can deny or withdraw it at any time in your device settings. If you deny it, the display shows the weather of the city chosen by the board owner, and we don't ask again: your choice is stored on this device until you delete your account (or clear the browser data).
page.x_suaPosicaoFicaGuardadaApenas: Your position is stored only on your device, for up to 30 minutes. We do not link the position to your account and do not store it in the database.
page.x_paraBuscarOTempoO: To fetch the weather, the Pinz server receives the rounded position (about 1 km) and passes it to the weather forecast service; to show the city name, it also passes it to the maps service. The server keeps the response for a few minutes (the weather) or for one day (the city name), together with the rounded position, without identifying you.
page.x_seuMuralSoAbrePara: Your board only opens for those who answer the question you set. Pins marked as secret appear blurred to visitors. When you leave a pin on someone else's board, it is signed with your username.
page.x_supabaseBancoDeDadosLogin: Supabase: database, login and file storage.
page.x_googleLoginComOGoogle: Google: Google login and maps and place search (Google Maps).
page.x_metNorwayApiMetNo: MET Norway (api.met.no): weather forecast for the Weather display, from the rounded position.
page.x_openstreetmapNominatimNomeDaCidade: OpenStreetMap (Nominatim): city name for the position of whoever allows location.
page.x_cloudflareProtecaoEEntregaDo: Cloudflare: protection and delivery of the site.
page.x_mercadoPagoPagamentosDaAssinatura: Mercado Pago: payments for the subscription and credits. Card or Pix data is entered directly on Mercado Pago; Pinz neither receives nor stores it, only the payment result.
page.x_essesServicosTratamOsDados: These services process data under their own policies and may process it outside Brazil.
page.x_vocePodePedirAcessoCorrecao: You can request access, correction or deletion of your data and account, and delete your pins at any time from the board itself. We keep the data while the account exists; reports and security logs may be kept for as long as needed to protect other people.
page.x_oPinzNaoEDestinado: Pinz is not intended for children under 13.
page.x_stripePagamentosEmDolar: Stripe: payments in US dollars for people outside Latin America and Portugal. Card data is entered directly on Stripe; Pinz neither receives nor stores it, only the payment result.

page.x_aoCriarUmaContaOu: By creating an account or using Pinz (pinz.digital), you agree to these terms.
page.x_oPinzPermiteCriarUm: Pinz lets you create a personal board, or one shared between two people, and leave pins (messages, photos, songs and other formats) on boards. Some features are part of the PINZ+ plan.
page.x_voceEResponsavelPeloAcesso: You are responsible for access to your account and for what you publish with it.
page.x_oNomeDeUsuarioE: The username is chosen once and may not imitate brands, companies or other people.
page.x_naoEPermitidoPublicarConteudo: It is not allowed to publish illegal content, content that harasses, threatens or exposes other people, that violates third-party rights or that contains nudity or violence. You declare that you have the right to publish what you send.
page.x_pinsPodemSerDenunciadosPodemos: Pins can be reported. We may remove content and suspend accounts that violate these terms.
page.x_oPinzEUmaAssinatura: PINZ+ is a monthly subscription (R$ 9.90, or the equivalent amount in US dollars for those paying through Stripe) charged by Mercado Pago or Stripe, and credits are sold in separate packs. Prices appear before purchase.
page.x_vocePodeCancelarAAssinatura: You can cancel the subscription at any time, from within Pinz, with no penalty. PINZ+ continues until the end of the period already paid and there are no new charges.
page.x_vocePodeDesistirDeUma: You can withdraw from a purchase within 7 days, as provided by the Brazilian Consumer Protection Code, and request a refund through Pinz contact. Credits already spent in the store are deducted.
page.x_seAAssinaturaDeixarDe: If the subscription stops being paid, the account returns to the free plan: your pins stay, but PINZ+ features become unavailable.
page.x_osCreditosNaoSaoDinheiro: Credits are not money and cannot be transferred or withdrawn.
page.x_fazemosOPossivelParaManter: We do our best to keep the service online, but it is provided as is, with no guarantee of uninterrupted operation. We may change or discontinue features, and these terms, with notice.
page.x_oUsoDosSeusDados: The use of your data is described in the <s0>Privacy Policy</s0>.
